videos.title: I Replaced My Entire Team With AI Agents (Live n8n Demo)
videos.description:
At WeAreDevelopers Berlin, I demonstrated how my AI chief of staff "Charlie" completely runs CloudStation's operations. Watch me scan business cards and generate leads using nothing but WhatsApp messages.

🎯 Live Demo Highlights:
- Business card → automatic CRM update in seconds
- Voice command generates 10 qualified developer leads  
- Multi-agent system with specialized AI roles
- Real-time n8n workflow execution

🔧 Technical Deep Dive:
- n8n workflow automation architecture
- MCP server integration with Twenty CRM
- PostgreSQL + Qdrant database setup
- Router agent pattern for AI coordination
- Memory management that learns from mistakes

Perfect for startup founders looking to automate operations and developers interested in practical AI implementation.

The system costs less than one employee but works 24/7 with zero oversight.

#AI #Startup #n8n #Automation #WeAreDevelopers
